name: paranoidal-achievements
title: Paranoidal Achievements
author: FactorioParanoidal; based on Milestones by Wiwiweb, MxlChievements by Mxlppxl and More Achievements by LuziferSenpai
description: Achievements and milestones of the Paranoidal modpack in one mod. Achievements: the production achievements of MxlChievements 3.0.1 and More Achievements 0.0.2, plus achievements for the whole Paranoidal mod set — Angels and Bob, quality and defects, energy, trains and Factorissimo, Rampant and Big Monsters, space, challenges and scripted ones (deaths, distances, rockets, seasons, ruins and legendary ruins); achievements whose targets are missing are skipped and scripted tracking never stops the game. Milestones (fork of Milestones 1.4.7): when your force first made key items, fluids, kills and research, with a window (Ctrl+Alt+M), presets from other mods and chat messages. One event dispatch and one read of the production statistics for both. Replaces Milestones and MxlChievements-Reforged.
